Welcome.title: Welcome to Canada
Welcome.subtitle: Official information, explained in your language.
Welcome.privacy: No account needed. Asking questions never affects your immigration status.

Onboarding.title: A few questions
Onboarding.intro: Your answers help us show the steps that fit you. They stay private.

status.question: What is your situation in Canada?

arrival.question: When did you arrive in Canada?

children.question: Do you have children under 18 with you?

seniors.question: Does someone aged 65 or older live with you?

needs.question: What do you need help with first?

Roadmap.title: Your roadmap
Roadmap.noDocuments: The official page lists what you need.
Roadmap.ruleChanged: This rule may have changed. Check the official page.
Roadmap.draft: Draft: our team has not checked this step yet. Always check the official page.
Roadmap.offline: You are offline. This is your saved roadmap.
Roadmap.noProfile: Answer a few questions to see your roadmap.
Roadmap.allDone: You finished every step. Well done!

Ask.title: Ask a question
Ask.intro: Ask about health cards, benefits, school, work and more. Answers come only from official government pages.
Ask.example1: How do I get a health card?
Ask.example2: Can my children get the Canada Child Benefit?
Ask.example3: Where can I take free English classes?
Ask.thanks: Thank you. This helps us improve.
Ask.handoff_case_specific: This is about your own case. A settlement worker can help, for free.
Ask.handoff_not_found: A settlement worker can help you find the answer, for free.
Ask.handoff_urgent: A person can help you right away.
Ask.handoffButton: Ask for help from a person
Ask.scamWarning: This could be a scam. Do not pay or share personal information yet.

Voice.idle: Ready. Press the button to talk.
Voice.micBody: We use the microphone only while you talk to Arrive. Your voice is sent to our voice service (ElevenLabs) so it can understand you.
Voice.denied: The microphone is blocked. You can type your question instead.

Letters.title: Understand a letter
Letters.intro: Take a photo of a letter from the government, a bank or a landlord. We explain it in your language.
Letters.privacy: Your photo is deleted right after reading. We never save it.
Letters.fileTypes: Photo (JPG, PNG, HEIC) or PDF, up to 10 MB.
Letters.needAction: Do I need to do something?
Letters.suspicious: This letter has warning signs of a scam.
Letters.sampleNote: Never share your SIN, bank or card numbers with someone who contacts you first.

Scam.title: Is it real?
Scam.intro: Got a strange call, text, email or letter? Tell us what it said. We check it against official fraud warnings.
Scam.inputLabel: What did they say or ask for?
Scam.placeholder: For example: A caller said I owe the CRA money and must pay with gift cards today.
Scam.report: Report it to the Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre
Scam.reassurance: You did the right thing by checking. Asking never affects your immigration status.

Help.title: Talk to a person
Help.intro: Settlement workers help newcomers for free. They can explain your options, help with forms and find services near you.
Help.needLabel: What do you need help with?
Help.needHint: Write in any language. Do not include ID numbers.
Help.consent: I agree that Arrive shares my request and contact details with a settlement worker so they can contact me.
Help.successBody: A settlement worker will contact you. This is what we sent:
Help.emergency: If you are in danger now, call 911.

Settings.title: Accessibility settings
Settings.simpleModeHint: Fewer things on the screen and bigger buttons.
Settings.deleteBody: This deletes your answers and roadmap from Arrive and from this phone.
Settings.deleteConfirm: Are you sure? This cannot be undone.

Trust.title: How Arrive works
Trust.sourcesBody: Answers come only from official pages of the Government of Canada (canada.ca), the Government of Ontario (ontario.ca) and the City of Ottawa (ottawa.ca). Every answer shows its source and when we last checked it. If the pages do not have the answer, we say so and offer a person.
Trust.adviceBody: Arrive explains official information. It does not tell you what to decide about your own immigration case. For that, a settlement worker or a lawyer can help.
Trust.loggedBody: For each question we keep only: the topic, the language, the city, and whether we could answer. This helps the government see what newcomers need.
Trust.notLoggedBody: Your questions, your name, your phone number, your email, your address or photos of your letters. If you ask to talk to a person, only what you write in that form is shared with a settlement worker, with your permission.
Trust.groupsBody: Government staff only see totals. Groups smaller than 5 people are hidden.
Trust.deleteBody: Go to accessibility settings and choose "Delete my data".
Trust.status: Using Arrive never affects your immigration status.
Trust.voiceBody: Voice conversations and read-aloud audio are processed by our voice service, ElevenLabs. Answers are made with Google Gemini. Arrive does not keep your questions in its own records.
